jobs.occupation: Test Method Specialist, Quality Assurance Lifecycle Laboratory
jobs.description:
**_Imagine if robust test methods and reliable test equipment helped ensure the quality of both new and existing Coloplast products. That is where you come in.

**_As our new Test Method Specialist, you will become the technical focal point for selected test methods and related equipment in Coloplast Mørdrup, primarily supporting the QA Lifecycle Laboratory and Pilot SVS. This is a practical, hands-on specialist role in which you will work directly with laboratory equipment, including troubleshooting, service and calibration follow-up, qualification, and software and computer upgrades. You will support the full test method and equipment lifecycle, from implementation and qualification to maintenance, transfer and continuous improvement.

If you are motivated by hands-on technical problem-solving, equipment responsibility, quality assurance and data evaluation, this role offers meaningful responsibility and broad organisational impact. You will also work closely with many internal and external stakeholders, making clear communication, coordination and strong stakeholder management an important part of your success.

_“In this role, your technical judgement and ability to create robust solutions will help ensure reliable test results and compliant laboratory processes throughout the product lifecycle,” says Lotte Stoklund, Team Manager, QA Lifecycle Laboratory.

_**Join a skilled and collaborative laboratory team

**At our Coloplast Mørdrup site, you will join the Quality Assurance Lifecycle Laboratory. The team consists of laboratory technicians and test method specialists who work closely together to support ongoing production, process development, quality investigations and test method activities.

You will be part of an engaged team with a strong mix of practical laboratory experience and specialist knowledge. In our daily work, we collaborate closely with colleagues across Quality Assurance, Research and Development, Operations, Global Test Method teams and international manufacturing sites. We value curiosity, knowledge sharing, flexibility and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Own and develop test methods and equipment

**As Test Method Specialist, you will act as a one-point contact and technical superuser for selected test methods and test equipment. A significant part of the role is practical equipment responsibility. You will work hands-on with equipment and coordinate activities to ensure it is qualified, calibrated, serviced, maintained and performing as intended. You will also support software and computer upgrades connected to the equipment, as well as reliable data handling and traceability.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

• Acting as technical owner and one-point contact for selected test methods and related test equipment

• Planning, coordinating and performing qualification of test equipment, including relocation, capacity expansion and replacement of critical parts

• Preparing and maintaining qualification protocols, reports, procedures, test method documentation and one-point lessons when needed

• Performing hands-on troubleshooting of test equipment and methods, evaluating test results and leading root cause investigations when failures occur

• Taking practical responsibility for test equipment, including service activities, calibration follow-up, preventive maintenance and ensuring that equipment performs as intended

• Handling changes, nonconformities and CAPAs related to test methods, calibration and test equipment

• Supporting compliant storage and traceability of raw data before product release

• Planning and participating in transfers of test methods and equipment to international manufacturing sites

• Providing technical support and sparring to colleagues in the Pilot Plant, Global Operations and international manufacturing sites

• Collaborating with Global Test Method teams and contributing technical input to the development and improvement of test methods

• Training specialists, laboratory technicians, operators and other users in test methods, test principles and use of equipment

• Coordinating software and computer upgrades for test equipment, assessing their impact on qualification and documentation, and managing suppliers, service visits and relevant service agreements

• Participating in internal and external audits related to test methods, equipment and documentation

• Contributing to continuous improvement of laboratory processes, systems and ways of working

**Bring strong technical judgement and a quality mindset

**To succeed in this position, you combine technical depth with a structured, practical and hands-on approach. You enjoy working directly with equipment, take ownership and work systematically when resolving technical issues. You are comfortable making decisions based on data, risk and regulatory requirements.

The role involves close collaboration with many internal and external stakeholders, therefor you communicate clearly, coordinate effectively and are able to build strong working relationships across functions, sites and suppliers.

We imagine that you bring:

• A master’s degree within science, engineering, mechanics, physics, chemistry, pharmacy or a comparable technical field, or have at least five years of relevant experience with test methods

• Solid hands-on experience with test methods, measurement principles and qualification of laboratory or production test equipment

• Strong problem-solving skills and experience with structured root cause analysis

• Confident evaluating, analysing and presenting technical data skills, including the use of statistical methods

• Ability to write, review and understand technical documentation, protocols and reports

• Knowledge of quality systems and regulated environments; knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 and GMP is an advantage

• An understanding of validation, calibration, design control, specifications and process risk management

• Abitlity to plan and prioritise your work effectively and follow activities through to completion

• Strong stakeholder management skills and collaborate effectively across disciplines, functions, geographical locations and external suppliers

• Communicating skills professionally in English, both written and spoken; Danish is an advantage

• A comfortable competence using digital tools for documentation, data analysis and traceability; experience with Microsoft Office, Veeva, JMP or similar systems is an advantage

**A specialist role with broad impact

**This is a permanent specialist position in the QA Lifecycle Laboratory. The role has no direct reports and includes collaboration with international colleagues and manufacturing sites. Some travel may be expected in connection with transfers, supplier activities and site support.

You will join a working environment where quality, safety, technical excellence, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are central to our daily work. You will have the opportunity to build a broad network and influence how test methods and equipment are managed across the product lifecycle.

**Interested?

**If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Lotte Stoklund, Team Manager, QA Lifecycle Laboratory, at dklst@coloplast.com.

We invite candidates for interviews continuously, so we encourage you to submit your CV with a description of your motivation for applying, as soon as possible.

Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

jobs.occupation: Associate Director, Trial Delivery Team Lead
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Overview

**The Associate Director, Trial Delivery Team Lead plays a key leadership role in overseeing Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs) and Clinical Trial Associates (CTAs) while supporting the broader Clinical Trial Management (CTM) organization. This individual ensures high-quality clinical trial execution by providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and operational oversight. The Line Manager is responsible for team development, resource allocation, process optimization, and ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory standards. The Trial Delivery Team Lead may assume Global Trial Lead (GTL) responsibilities to address fluctuating demands.

**Roles & Responsibilities

****Leadership and Line Management:

**

• Directly manage, mentor, and develop Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs) and Clinical Trial Associates (CTAs), fostering professional growth.

• Conduct performance evaluations, provide feedback, and identify training and career development opportunities.

• Ensure adequate resourcing, workload distribution, and succession planning within the team.

• Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and knowledge-sharing within the clinical operations team.

• Collaborate with Global Trial Leads (GTLs) on trial activities for assigned direct reports.

• Support trial deliverables by facilitating progress, coaching, and mentoring CTMs and CTAs.

• Advise on resource needs and support overall clinical trial resource planning.

• Ensure team success through setting clear expectations, guiding performance, and leading competency development.

• Lead functional working groups; serve as process owner or Subject Matter Expert (SME) within Clinical Operations.

• Support training initiatives across Trial Operations as needed.

• Collaborate with senior leadership to define and implement best practices within the Development Operations organization.

**Process & Compliance Management

**

• Ensure team adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, and regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, etc.).

• Develop and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to optimize trial efficiency and compliance.

• Support audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions by ensuring inspection readiness across clinical trials.

• Identify and drive process improvements to enhance trial execution and data quality.

• Lead cross-trial initiatives as needed, such as implementation of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) or new process rollouts across the program.

• Manages the execution and implementation of CTM and CTA tasks, ensuring operational success.

• Initiates and supports the development of processes within the CTM and CTA group, focusing on practical application and continuous improvement.

• Collaborates across functions to drive efficiencies and provide day-to-day guidance to the CTM and CTA groups.

**Requirements – What You Must Have

**

• Bachelor of science degree with relevant specialization; Master of science degree preferred

• Minimum requirement of 12 or more years of experience in clinical operations

• Significant experience in leading and managing complex global clinical projects/programs

• Significant experience managing/guiding internal (cross-functional) and external (CRO, regulatory authorities) teams

• Experience with operational management and budget planning

• Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role

• Global clinical program level experience required

• Experience within the field of oncology is preferred

• Minimum 2 years’ experience as Clinical Operations representative in Clinical Development Teams (CDTs) or Global Project Teams (GPTs) would be preferable

• Experience leading team members in global matrix environment, leveraging tools and technology to ensure business needs are met.

• Strategic thinking with ability to optimize organizational resources for successful program execution

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• Dedicated team player who enjoys leading teams and inspire trust among colleagues

• Quality mindset and able to prioritize your work in a fast paced and changing environment

• Result- and goal-oriented and committed to contributing to the overall success of Genmab

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$158,720.00---$238,080.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.description:
Could your expertise in ecotoxicology help shape better environmental decisions—and unlock new opportunities for science-led advisory services?

At DHI, you’ll connect ecotoxicology, environmental science and water modelling to help clients tackle complex challenges in aquatic environments. Join our international Environment & Toxicology team to broaden your impact while helping grow our environmental advisory business.

Responsibilities and Challenges

We are looking for a senior colleague with expertise in ecotoxicology and environmental science with insights and interests in developing our advisory solutions and business.

As a member of DHI’s international Environment & Toxicology team, you will help clients address complex challenges related to chemicals, ecotoxicology and the aquatic environment. You will work closely with clients and colleagues across disciplines to develop practical, science-based solutions that protect human health and the environment.

The main responsibilities are to:

• Deliver expert advisory within the area of regulatory and scientific aspects of eco-toxicology, environmental exposure- and risk assessment, management of chemicals and/or environmental hazardous substances in water environments, and other client projects.

• Lead business development within advisory area of environment and eco-toxicology, enabling and bringing to life the strategy to build on the markets for advisory on environmental exposure- and risk assessment, management of chemicals and/or environmental hazardous substances (incl. micropollutants) in water environments.

• Plan and execute of internal and external activities of knowledge distribution (i.e. network meetings, conferences or courses) as well as business development activities.

• Serve as project manager in own projects, as well as deliver as project participant in projects within the portfolio.

• Perform quality assurance and mentor young colleagues, ensuring high scientific level of solutions.

• Establish and maintain good practices for international collaboration in E&T.

What We're Looking For

Required education, experience and capabilities

• A relevant university degree in ecotoxicology, environmental chemistry, environmental science, biology, chemistry, chemical engineering, water or environmental engineering, or a closely related discipline. A PhD or other advanced qualification is an advantage.

• At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in ecotoxicology, environmental chemistry, environmental risk assessment, chemicals in the environment or a closely related advisory field.

• A strong professional track record gained in consultancy, industry, public authority, research organization, or a comparable environment.

• Demonstrated experience assessing chemicals or environmentally hazardous substances in aquatic or water-related environments.

• Experience leading technically complex projects, including responsibility for scope, quality, budget, schedule and stakeholder management.

• A proven ability to originate or develop business, build client relationships and contribute to successful proposals or tenders.

• A good understanding of relevant environmental regulation, market developments and the needs of industry and public-sector clients.

• Experience working in an international or multidisciplinary setting.

• Proficient in English (professional level)

Additional experience and strengths, which will contribute to success in this role:

• Experience with establishing environmental quality standards and predicted no-effect concentrations, and/or assessing chemicals in wastewater or other water environments

• Knowledge of the EU Water Framework Directive, Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive, Drinking Water Directive or related national requirements.

• Experience with environmental fate, transport or exposure modelling

• Collaboration with authorities, utilities, industrial clients, industry associations, research programmes or international consortia.

• Experience developing services or markets across Denmark and the wider European region.

• Serving as the technical lead and/or mentor for colleagues in a team.

Skills and competences

The successful candidate combines scientific credibility with commercial awareness and a genuine interest in understanding client needs. We are looking for a person who can translate complex scientific and regulatory matters into clear advice and practical solutions.

You are:

• Scientifically strong, with the ability to provide authoritative advice within your field.

• Client-oriented and commercially aware, with the confidence to initiate conversations, develop opportunities and build lasting professional relationships.

• An effective project leader, able to maintain direction and quality across technically complex assignments.

• A clear communicator, capable of engaging scientific experts, decision-makers, authorities and other stakeholders.

• Collaborative and internationally oriented, with an interest in working across disciplines, markets and organisational boundaries.

• Proactive and accountable, taking ownership and exercising sound professional judgement.

• Generous with your expertise, contributing to knowledge sharing, mentoring and the professional development of colleagues.

Why join DHI?

To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that is the global leader in solving the world’s toughest challenges in water, environment and sustainability.

In this position we offer to you the opportunity to join a strong company with dedicated colleagues to:

• Shape and grow DHI’s ecotoxicology and environmental advisory business.

• Work at the intersection of chemicals, water environments, environmental regulation and data-driven decision-making.

• Collaborate with ecotoxicologists, environmental scientists, toxicologists, water specialists and modellers across an international organisation.

• Lead meaningful assignments for industry, authorities, utilities and partners.

• Take on a visible expert role with opportunities to influence strategy, develop clients, lead projects and mentor colleagues.

DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading edge MIKE technologies and products to the market. At DHI, we are constantly looking for passionate and talented people who are eager to join our team.

By joining DHI, you will not only become part of a dynamic and collaborative global team of experts; you will be empowered to innovate, engage and grow in your area of expertise. DHI is committed to disseminate our knowledge effectively and across our worldwide network of offices.

Location & Mobility

• The role location is at DHI office, Hørsholm, Denmark

Travelling must be expected in the role to enable collaboration with clients and/or inside DHI. Travelling rules as included in employment contract

How to apply

• Please submit your application including CV via the relevant job posting on DHI’s website: http://www.dhigroup.com/careers

• Deadline for application is 26th November 2026.

• For further information please contact Yong Quan Lim, Talent Acquisition Specialist by by email liyq@dhigroup.com / Lise Lyck, Senior manager, Environment & Toxicology by email lly@dhigroup.com.

What you’ll do

As a senior member of the AI team, you will help shape how we build with Large Language Models and agentic systems across our products, contributing to high‑level design decisions, turning ambiguous business problems into robust system designs, and ensuring high‑quality coding standards and design. jobs.occupation: PhD stipend in thermal modeling and advanced solutions for high-power modules and magnetic components
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend is available within the general study programme in Electrical and Electronic Engineering. The stipend is open for appointment from 1 December 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years and the position is full-time.

Your work tasks
The position is offered in relation to the GreenMag project, and you will be positioned in the Section of Power Electronics Systems and Materials within the research programme Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification (SPELL) at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will be based at the Aalborg campus in a highly international research environment with close collaboration with academic and industrial partners in the field of power electronics and energy systems.

The increasing electrification of transport, industry and renewable energy systems is driving the development of high-power-density power converters operating at megawatt levels. Advanced planar magnetic components are emerging as a key technology for achieving higher power density, manufacturability and integration in such converters. However, thermal management remains one of the major challenges that limit the performance, reliability and scalability of planar magnetic solutions, especially at high power and high frequency.

In this PhD project, you will work on the development of innovative thermal management technologies for megawatt planar magnetics used in future electrification systems. Your research will combine advanced modelling, experimental validation and prototype development to improve heat dissipation and thermal reliability while maintaining the required electrical and magnetic performance. You will analyse thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in high-power planar magnetic components, design and evaluate cooling concepts and contribute to the integration of these solutions in realistic converter systems.

You will conduct cutting-edge research on thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in megawatt-class planar magnetic components and use this knowledge to propose and evaluate new design strategies. You will develop multiphysics simulation models using finite element modelling tools to investigate the thermal performance of planar magnetics and to study alternative cooling concepts and material choices. You will design, manufacture and experimentally validate novel thermal management solutions for planar magnetic structures, and you will explore advanced materials and cooling technologies that can be applied in megawatt-class magnetic components. As part of the GreenMag project, you will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, disseminate your research results through publications in international journals and conferences, and contribute to teaching and supervision activities within the department as part of the PhD education programme.

Your competencies 
You have a relevant educational background within Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Energy Engineering or a closely related field, and you hold a Master’s degree that qualifies you for enrolment in the PhD programme. You are motivated to work at the interface between thermal science, electromagnetics and power electronics, and you are interested in both theoretical and experimental research.

You bring strong analytical skills and a structured approach to modelling and problem solving, and you are comfortable working with numerical tools for thermal and multiphysics analysis. Experience with thermal analysis, power electronics or magnetic component design will be considered an advantage, as will experience with finite element analysis tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or ANSYS. It is beneficial if you have worked with experimental testing, prototype development or laboratory work in previous projects and if you are prepared to work with both simulation and hands-on experiments in this PhD.

As a person, you are curious and creative, and you are motivated by addressing challenging research questions in collaboration with others. You are able to work independently, take responsibility for your project and contribute actively to collaborative research activities across groups and institutions. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as you will present your results in scientific publications, at international conferences and in meetings with project partners.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. Aalborg University is recognised internationally for excellence in power electronics and energy systems research, and AAU has been ranked among the leading universities in Europe within energy research. At AAU Energy, you will be part of a highly international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges associated with electrification and the green transition.

The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs approximately 300 staff members from a broad range of nationalities and disciplinary backgrounds, creating a vibrant international research environment with extensive opportunities for collaboration and professional growth. The department offers world-class laboratory and workshop facilities, and maintains close collaboration with industrial partners. As a PhD student, you will have access to advanced facilities for the design, manufacturing and testing of high-power magnetic components and power electronic systems, and you will be part of an active research community in Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Other relevant documents
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
